CustomField.description: Google Cloud API key for the Maps JavaScript API. Loaded by SchoolMapPage.page to render the interactive map shown during the parent application flow. Restrict the key in Google Cloud by HTTP referrer to the Experience Cloud site domain(s). This is distinct from the server-side Geocoding API key, which lives in the Google_Maps_Geocoding External Credential.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Google Maps JavaScript API key. Paste the browser-side key created in Google Cloud Console (restricted by HTTP referrer).
CustomField.label: Browser API Key
